message:
perf: send to the main frame without crossing the boundary twice (#54209)

webContents.send() reached the frame through the mainFrame accessor, a
full call into C++ that looks up or builds a WebFrameMain wrapper, and
then made a second call to send. Resolve the primary main frame in C++
so a send crosses once. The channel check and error handling move to the
webContents wrapper unchanged: a destroyed contents or missing frame
still throws a TypeError, a serialization failure is still logged.

Saves roughly 250 ns per send on a testing build; the rest of a send is
serialization and mojo.
